usecases.title: Deliver the Halo smart lamp launch spot
Inspect storyboard cuts in a browser contact sheet

criteria.text: Each delivered cut runs at 30 frames per second.

expected.operand: every text layer in every frame is fully inside the frame

criteria.text: All text in each cut stays fully inside the frame.

expected.operand: round white smart lamp glowing warm amber in a dark, minimal living room during 0:00–0:03

criteria.text: In the product hero, a round white smart lamp glows warm amber in a dark, minimal living room.

expected.operand: lamp layer fully inside frame at 0:01

criteria.text: The product-hero lamp is fully inside the frame by 0:01.
The product-hero caption reads exactly “Light that listens”.
The product-hero caption is fully visible by 0:01.
During the colour shot, the lamp's glow shifts from amber to soft blue.

expected.operand: price tag visible with exact rendered text $89 at each of 0:04 and 0:05

criteria.text: The colour-shot price tag reads exactly $89 at both 0:04 and 0:05.

expected.operand: HALO wordmark visible in each frame of shot 3 from 0:06 through the end

criteria.text: The HALO wordmark is visible throughout 0:06–0:10.
The call-to-action button reads exactly “Pre-order now”.
The call-to-action button is fully visible by 0:08.

expected.operand: text or button overlapping the top 14% of any portrait frame

criteria.text: No text or button in the 9:16 cut occupies the top 14% of its frame.

expected.operand: text or button overlapping the bottom 35% of any portrait frame

criteria.text: No text or button in the 9:16 cut occupies the bottom 35% of its frame.

tests.title: Landscape colour shift and price at both timecodes
tests.summary: Landscape shot 0:03–0:06 shifts amber to soft blue and shows exact $89 at both stated timecodes.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: In the landscape contact-sheet frames labelled within the 0:03–0:06 colour shot, inspect the lamp glow as the shot progresses, then assert it shifts from amber to soft blue during that shot.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: In the landscape contact sheet, inspect the price tag and its exact rendered text in both frames labelled 0:04 and 0:05, then assert the tag is visible and reads exactly $89 at each timecode.

tests.title: Landscape hero lamp and caption at first-second deadline
tests.summary: Landscape hero at 0:00–0:03 shows the warm-amber round white lamp in the dark minimal living room, lamp and exact caption fully visible by 0:01.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the landscape contact-sheet header, inspect its measured cut width, height, duration, and frames per second, then assert the measurements are 1920×1080 pixels, 10 seconds, and 30 fps.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: In the landscape frames labelled within the 0:00–0:03 product-hero shot, inspect the room and lamp as the shot reaches 0:01, then assert a round white smart lamp glows warm amber in a dark, minimal living room and the lamp is fully inside the frame by 0:01.

steps.heading: Step 4
steps.body: In the landscape hero's frame labelled 0:01, inspect the caption and its facts-table row, then assert its exact rendered text is “Light that listens” and it is fully visible by 0:01.

tests.title: Landscape text never clips outside a frame
tests.summary: No text layer in any landscape frame extends beyond its frame.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the landscape contact sheet, inspect all text-layer facts-table rows across every labelled frame for the fully-inside-frame property, then assert every text layer in every frame is fully inside its frame.

tests.title: Landscape wordmark continuity and pre-order button deadline
tests.summary: Landscape shot 3 shows HALO wordmark throughout and the exact Pre-order now button fully visible by 0:08.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: Across every landscape contact-sheet frame labelled in shot 3 from 0:06 until the end, inspect the rendered wordmark and corresponding facts-table visibility, then assert HALO is visible throughout shot 3.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: In the landscape call-to-action frame labelled 0:08, inspect the button and its facts-table text and visibility, then assert the button reads exactly “Pre-order now” and is fully visible by 0:08.

tests.title: Portrait text and buttons avoid reserved horizontal bands
tests.summary: Across portrait frames, no text or button enters the top 14% or bottom 35% of the frame.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the portrait contact sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect the rendered text and button layers across every labelled frame against the shaded top 14% and bottom 35% bands, then assert no text or button overlaps either reserved horizontal band.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: On the portrait contact sheet, inspect every text-layer row in the facts table for every frame, then assert every text layer is fully inside its frame.
